QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Remembering the Journey
QuestInfo.0:
#e#bAlliance Mission - Remembering the Journey#k#n

#bMission Period#k
Following the defeat of the Black Mage until 1/23/2019 at 12:00 AM

The fierce battle with the Black Mage has finally come to an end, and it's time to revel in the Alliance's achievement. You've saved the world from crisis! Now it's time for a little R & R. That's right, rejuvenation and revitalization efforts!

Defeat #bmonsters near your level#k to acquire #bPeaceful Maple Leaves#k. When you gather enough, you'll be able to use #b1 of 4 special skills#k. You'll get additional #bdetermination#k when you use one of these #bskills#k, and you can gain even more if you defeat a monster with that #bskill#k.

#bThe Cleansing Light won't activate again after you've collected 50,000 determination for the day.#k
#bThe Cleansing Light won't activate in some areas, including Tenebris.#k
